wasm-inspector.description: Compiles kernel-zig to wasm32, inspects binary footprint, and enumerates exported zero-copy C-ABI symbols

cad-oracle-fuzzer.description: Executes differential fuzzing against OpenCASCADE/PlaneGCS oracle harness, checking <= 1e-7 mm deviation and Euler-Poincaré invariants

cpp-ast-slicer.description: Surgically extracts isolated C++ classes, structs, or functions with bounded line limits to prevent agent context flooding
